resources.string: Weather effects: fog banks, rain, water spray. Special effects: steam, heat shimmer, water. Off saves graphics work on weaker devices; muzzle flashes, blood, explosions, fire, hits and hints stay, and so does every effect in cut scenes.
Auto aim: when you raise your weapon, the aim jumps to the nearest enemy in front of you and follows it for a moment (the game\'s own lock-on).
Always run: Leon runs whenever you move; hold the run button (e.g. B) to walk instead.
Keeps the shoulder camera a little further behind Leon while walking and standing. Aiming and tight spots bring it close as before; it moves smoothly in between.
While the graphics lag, skips a picture so the game keeps its normal speed. Fewer pictures are shown, nothing is slowed down.

The switches stay on until you switch them off; your save does not keep them. Some attacks still kill Leon at once (a chainsaw, a grab, a boulder). The buttons change your game: the weapon, the case and the money stay in your next save. Automatic QTEs presses the buttons of every quick-time prompt for you. Unlock extra games adds Assignment Ada and The Mercenaries to the title menu, as after finishing the game; your next save keeps them. Invisibility: enemies take no notice of you and do not attack; bosses and scripted scenes still can.
%1$s already owned: now at its highest levels.
Not now: only while Leon plays, not in the case, the map or a movie.
No room in the attaché case.
Will be done as soon as the game runs.
This game core has no cheats.
To play another version: the game ends, and you import both of its discs on the start screen. Saves, memory card and settings stay.

Resolution: the game\'s picture as a share of the GameCube\'s 640 × 528 points; lower is faster. The simplified colour calculation saves graphics work; colours may differ very slightly. View distance: how far you see before the distance fog; what lies behind it is not drawn. It takes effect at the next door or cut scene.
